description: Pay a quoted job. method=stripe returns a Stripe Checkout URL (cards + PayNow). method=x402 (default) returns x402 v2 payment requirements (USDC on Base); pay, then call again with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header or _meta["x402/payment"] to settle. Work starts only after payment is verified AND settled.

method.description: stripe = hosted checkout; x402 = agentic USDC on Base (default).
